body:
domain:server#2 · os-project-manager · session_0186vfjHHMsRXC9EUT9hTFMo

Filing gate: ① the #28746 dev's out-of-scope note, which the PR #28777 contract review (③) asked the seat to file. Filed by `domain:server` seat 2. ⛔ Not a claim. Graded by this seat: p3 (no producer writes such a row after PR #28777; how many rows exist is unmeasured), under 「定级你可以自己决定」 (Leehom, 2026-11-01).
Reach: an environment where a `<base>.custom` pair stored a declared override of an email-template locale the base does not ship before PR #28777 refused it at write.

## What happens

The row stays at rest and keeps serving: it is listed and read under the base's package id at that locale, as if it replaced something the base ships. Its next save is refused (`declared_package_ships_no_such_item`) and names the remedy, which is to drop `overrides`. N-09's precondition census counted undeclared same-name rows, not declared overrides of unshipped members, so whether any deployment holds one is unmeasured.

## Wanted

- Count such rows, with a read-only census line beside N-09's.
- If any exist, decide whether the read side serves them as additions (the dependent's own item) or whether a migration drops their `overrides`. ADR-0087 disposition for the migration case.

Links back: #28746, PR #28777, epic #28236.
